title: Sinking Simulator 3D ?
author: bubblebg
selftext: This is what it managed to do today ( Opus 5 high & 5.6 Sol medium). I know everything is bare-bones right now, but it's important to get the essentials to work...

replies.author: bubblebg
replies.body: Well, it's not one shot; I'm usually prompting a general idea of what I want and then going back and forth, implementing piece by piece, asking to fix issues, bugs, etc. A realistic sinking simulator with GPU-accelerated physics (with either Unreal, Unity, or Godot ) is a good starting point and similar to what I wrote. I'm not ready to share it yet in this state xd.

comments.author: NMS_Ships_Pets_Tools
comments.body:
ok so I will preface this by saying I am a pretty anti-AI person... with that aside;  
I think this is actually pretty cool. I really like ship sinking stuff cause I'm easily entertained and it's so unfortunate we don't really have a 3D game LIKE "Sinking Simulator." The closest thing is "From The Depths" but it's more like a ship builder and combat game that just happens to have sinking. I will keep eye on this project of yours :-)
